bundle.shortDescription: Local-first AI workbench with lossless prompt compression
bundle.longDescription: Thalamus Desktop combines an AI chat, a project workspace (file explorer, editor, terminal) and an agent-mode copilot in one desktop application. A pure-Rust prompt-compression engine rewrites structured parts of a prompt into a compact table, verifies the round trip, and reports the tokens and cost saved. The backend listens on 127.0.0.1 only and API keys stay in the Windows credential vault.
